Offset.name: Open Offset Settings...
Offset.description: Opens Settings for HUD and song offsets.

Graphics.name: Framerate
Graphics.description: Changes the max framerate of the game!

Visuals & UI.name: Hide HUD
Visuals & UI.description: Hides the game HUD. Use this if you only want to focus on the notes!

Visuals & UI.name: Time Bar
Visuals & UI.description: Change what the time bar displays! If at all.

Visuals & UI.name: Debug Mode
Visuals & UI.description: Enables debug mode, which displays your FPS and memory usage in the top left of your screen, and allows you to use a host of debug keys while in song!

Gameplay.name: Downscroll
Gameplay.description: Notes will fall from the top, requiring you to hit them at the bottom.

Gameplay.name: Middlescroll
Gameplay.description: Moves the player notes to the middle.

Gameplay.name: Ghost Tapping
Gameplay.description: No penalty for tapping an arrow that doesn't have a note!

Save Data.name: Delete your save data...
Save Data.description: Delete your existing save data for Friday Night Funkin': The Origami King.
